### Context: <br>
We have a data set from a former student's biology thesis.
[**butterflies_pesticides.xlsx**](butterflies_pesticides.xlsx) reports the mean wing length for 80 butterflies (40 of which were treated with pesticides during the larval stage (labeled Group2) and 40 that were not (control group labeled 1))

Our task will be to examine how pesticides impact butterfly development.
Let's start with the Butterfly Pesticides Data.

Assume that we want to test to see if there is a difference between butterfly wing length for those treated with pesticides (group 2) and those not treated with pesticides (group 1).

### Steps to guide your analysis
#### Use the following steps to guide your work in R:
1- Assess the normality of the wing-length data and report the relevant results.<br>
2- Assess the equality of variances between the pesticide-treated and control groups and report the relevant results.<br>
3- Conduct the appropriate statistical test to compare wing length between the pesticide-treated and control groups.<br>
4- Report the test statistic, degrees of freedom (if applicable), and p-value. Determine whether the difference is statistically significant at α = 0.05.<br>
5- Create an appropriate ggplot to visualize and compare wing length between the two groups.<br>
6- Write a concise paragraph summarizing your research objective, methods, statistical results, and interpretation of the findings.

<br>

### Required submission / Entrega requerida
- Submit your R output, ggplot, and one summary paragraph. Your paragraph should include the research objective, a brief description of the methods, the statistical results, and an interpretation of the findings, including whether the observed difference appears biologically meaningful.<br>
- Entregue los resultados del análisis en R, el gráfico creado con ggplot y un párrafo de resumen. El párrafo debe incluir el objetivo de la investigación, una breve descripción de los métodos utilizados, los resultados estadísticos y una interpretación de los hallazgos, incluyendo si la diferencia observada parece tener relevancia biológica.
